Use case: illustration-story. Create one original, wholesome fantasy school comic page in Spanish, portrait 2:3, 1024x1536. SIX large sequential panels, clean expressive cartoon ink and warm full color matching the character references, cream gutters and clearly readable Spanish lettering. Reference 1: curly brown-haired Hermione in red/gold uniform and honey-blonde Sophie in yellow/black uniform. Reference 2: black-haired Harry with round glasses, red-haired Ron, long-red-haired Ginny, all in red/gold uniforms. All are fully dressed ordinary school characters. Show only the exact conversational scenes below. Balloons point unmistakably to the speaker. Captions are rectangular cream boxes. Header exactly 'Capítulo 2 · 03'. No extra dialogue or watermark.
1. In a quiet library alcove, Sophie stands with her books and smiles kindly at Hermione. SOPHIE says 'No tienes que responder ahora. Solo piénsalo, ¿sí?'. Hermione nods shyly. Caption 'Hermione no sabía qué hacer con aquel descubrimiento.'
2. Sophie waves goodbye while walking away among the bookshelves. Hermione remains in her armchair, smiling and thoughtful. Caption 'Después de aquella cariñosa despedida, Hermione se quedó pensando.'
3. Daylit castle staircase. Hermione descends happily, carrying her book and waving to a painted portrait. Caption 'Un par de horas después, ya había tomado una decisión.'
4. GREAT HALL dining table, floating candles and wooden benches with ordinary lunch food. Ron holds a roast chicken drumstick and complains to Harry: '¡No puedo creer que me rechazara! ¡Ni siquiera me dejó empezar!'. Ginny rolls her eyes. Caption 'Harper Byrne no estaba interesada. A Ron le costaba aceptarlo.'
5. Only Ron and Harry in this panel. RON says '¡Aún no tiene pareja! Lavender lo confirmó. Y coqueteó conmigo en Adivinación.' HARRY replies 'Ron… solo te pidió un cojín.' RON adds '¡No viste cómo me miró! Su mano rozó la mía.'
6. Harry glances at Ginny. She shrugs and takes a potato from his plate before returning to her Astronomy notes. Ron keeps grumbling silently in the background. No new speech and no Hermione at the dining table yet.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one original fantasy school comic page in Spanish, portrait 2:3, 1024x1536. SEVEN large sequential panels, expressive clean cartoon ink and warm full color matching the references, thin cream gutters and clearly readable large Spanish text. Reference 1 fixes Hermione (huge curly brown hair and freckles); reference 2 fixes Harry (black hair and round glasses), Ron (short red hair), Ginny (long red hair). All fully dressed in gray/black school uniforms with red and gold accents. Setting throughout: GREAT HALL lunch table, vaulted stone ceiling and floating candles, wooden benches, roast chicken, potatoes and pumpkin juice. Narration in rectangular cream captions; speech balloons point to the actual named speaker. Render ONLY the quoted text below; all other instructions are for the drawing. Header exactly 'Capítulo 2 · 04'. No watermark.
1. Hermione arrives smiling and pours pumpkin juice. RON asks '¿Dónde estuviste toda la mañana?'. HERMIONE replies 'Leyendo en la biblioteca.'
2. Only Ron and Hermione in the foreground. RON says 'Creí que vendrías al entrenamiento de Quidditch.' HERMIONE replies 'No quería pasar tres horas en las gradas. Además Luna no estaba.' RON responds 'Pero podrías verme a mí.' Hermione looks skeptical.
3. Only Ginny and Ron speaking, Harry listening behind them. GINNY says 'Tiene mejores cosas que hacer que verte hacer el ridículo en la escoba. Déjala en paz, Ronald.' RON, holding his drumstick, protests '¡No hice el ridículo! Tenía los brazos entumecidos por el frío.' Make the second balloon's tail clearly point to red-haired RON, never Hermione.
4. The friends laugh and discuss their practice. Hermione, now distracted, takes out a magical PAPER SCROLL. ONE narrator caption ONLY, no balloons: 'Los amigos hablaron del entrenamiento y del próximo partido contra Ravenclaw. Hermione escribió a Sophie.'
5. Close view of the parchment in Hermione's hands. Heading exactly 'Sophie'. Message exactly 'Tengo una respuesta. ¿Nos vemos antes de la cena en el patio central?'. No other writing.
6. Hermione looks up from the scroll and finds Ginny watching with a curious smile. RON asks from his nearby seat '¿A quién escribes? ¿Por qué sonríes tanto?'. His balloon tail points toward him.
7. Only Hermione and Ron speaking, Harry and Ginny silent behind. HERMIONE rolls up the parchment and says 'Estoy hablando con alguien.' RON asks '¿Con alguien? ¿Con quién?'. End here.
